provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Collector's Edition rule sheet (Legends, Extra! Extra!)

modules.name: Pearlbrook
modules.note: The rulebook recommends not mixing Pearlbrook with other expansion content.

modules.name: Spirecrest
modules.note: The rulebook recommends not mixing Spirecrest with other expansions.

modules.name: Newleaf
modules.note: With the Station board, the rulebook recommends leaving out Pearlbrook and Spirecrest.

modules.name: Mistwood cards
modules.note: Special Farms, Corrin Evertail and More Legends.

modules.name: Nightweave's Lair
modules.note: Mistwood's AI opponent; she counts as an extra player.

steps.text: Place the board and put the Ever Tree on the stump
Twigs, resin, pebbles and berries in piles along the river; point and occupied tokens beside the board
Shuffle Bellfaire's 4 Forest cards into the Forest deck
Shuffle Newleaf's 3 Forest cards into the Forest deck
Shuffle the Forest cards and place {n} on the clearings; return the rest
Place the 4 basic Event tiles along the river
Add Newleaf's 2 basic Events in their spots on the board
Place the Flower Festival basic Event beside the board
Place the Flower Festival in the middle of the basic Events
Remove the "Everdell Games" special Event
Include at least 1 Pearlbrook special Event
Mix in Bellfaire's special Events (or use 2 Bellfaire + 2 base)
Use 2 Bellfaire + 2 base special Events, a Bellfaire Event at each end of the row
Mix in Newleaf's special Events (or use 2 Newleaf + 2 base)
steps.note: Consider removing card-dependent base Events such as Flying Doctor Service

steps.text: Use only Newleaf and/or Bellfaire special Events
Shuffle the special Events and place {n} on the Ever Tree's lower branches; return the rest
Draw {n} Garland Award and place it faceup by the board
Market board beside the main board, 4 Market tokens on the "gain" side
Market board beside the main board, 4 Market tokens in a random row on the "trade" side
Shuffle the Pearlbrook cards into the main deck
Shuffle the Newleaf Critters and Constructions into the main deck
Shuffle the Extra! Extra! cards into the main deck
Swap the 8 base Farms for Mistwood's 8 special Farms
Shuffle the 5 Corrin Evertail cards into the main deck
Shuffle the main deck and deal {n} cards faceup into the Meadow
Put the deck inside the Ever Tree
River board beside the main board, pearls on the Shoal
Wonder boards under the Ever Tree covering the basic Event costs; Wonders on top
steps.note: Basic Events are not used with Pearlbrook

steps.text: Set aside {n} random River Citizens and {n} River Locations, shuffle those 4 and place 1 facedown on each River spot with a pearl on top
Each player takes a frog Ambassador in their color
Deal each player {n} Adornment cards facedown; return the rest unseen
steps.note: Adornments don't count toward the hand limit

steps.text: Place the Mountain board along the lower half of the main board
Sort the Weather cards by season; 1 random card facedown on each season spot
Remove Stormvale from the Peaks Discovery cards
Shuffle the Foothills, Peaks and Ridge Discovery decks separately; place them facedown on their spots
Give each player an Everdell map tile
Shuffle the map tiles: {n} faceup on the Foothills, {n} facedown on the Peaks and on the Ridge
Big Critters on the Mountain board or nearby
Reveal the winter Weather card; each player puts a Traveler on the start of the Foothills trail
Place the Station board along the right side of the main board
Shuffle the Visitor cards and split them into 2 faceup stacks on the platform
Deal {n} cards from the main deck faceup onto the Station
Train Car tiles in the bag; draw {n} onto the empty train cars
Each player takes {n} Golden occupied tokens
Each player takes a Ticket (Outbound side up) and a Reservation token (- side up)
Deal each player {n} Player Powers; each keeps 1
steps.note: With only Newleaf's or Mistwood's powers, deal 1 each

steps.text: Each player picks a color and takes {n} workers
Put your other workers on the Ever Tree: 1 spring, 1 summer, 2 autumn
Put your workers on the Ever Tree: 1 summer, 2 autumn - no spring worker
Put your workers on the Ever Tree: 1 summer, 2 autumn - no spring worker
Deal starting hands in turn order: {n} cards
Draw {n} cards
Each player draws {n} cards
Deal each player 1 Legendary Critter and 1 Legendary Construction, kept secret
steps.note: They don't count toward the hand limit

steps.text: Deal each player 1 Legendary Critter and 1 Legendary Construction, kept secret
steps.note: They don't count toward the hand limit

steps.text: Pick a color for Rugwort (he prefers black) and his year of difficulty (1-3)
Block the top-left Forest card with one Rugwort worker
Block the 3-twig space with his other worker
Roll for his Ambassador: 1-2 top River spot, 3-4 second, 5-6 third, 7-8 fourth. He takes its pearl, flip the card, give him 1 more pearl
An Everdell Valley tile and his Traveler go in Rugwort's area
Place both Nightweave boards beside the main board
Give Nightweave the 8-sided die
Give Nightweave the 12-sided die
steps.note: She gets no Golden tokens, Ticket or Reservation

steps.text: Deal Nightweave {n} facedown from the main deck as her hand
Pick a difficulty 0-4 and put that Scoring card by her boards
Remove the 2 Pearlbrook Activity cards
Sort the Activity cards by season
Pick 2 random winter cards with the spider worker: 1 back in the box, 1 aside. Shuffle the other 7 winter cards and put the set-aside card on top
steps.note: Her Activity deck starts with 8 cards

steps.text: Stack the other seasons faceup near her lair; Season token Winter side up
Nightweave and 2 spider workers in her lair; the other 6 under Prepare for Season
Replace her spring spider worker with a frog Ambassador
Hand limit is {n} cards
Second spaces on Forest cards are for 4 players only
Journey is only open in autumn
Prepare for spring and autumn: green cards produce. Summer: take up to 2 Meadow cards
After every Prepare for Season: Explore - chart, discover, travel
First visitor to a River spot takes its pearl and flips it
Only 1 of your workers on the Market at a time
After each card you play, roll the die: Rugwort plays that Meadow card (1 = top-left)
Rugwort keeps all his workers; no Rats power in solo
The most humble player (5-card hand) goes first; play is clockwise
You go first
Nightweave goes first, then turns alternate
Each turn: place a worker, play a card, or prepare for season
